security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Turn a folder of named WAV samples into a playable sampler instrument
bundle.longDescription: SampleArchitect maps convention-named WAV samples to keys, velocity layers and round robins, and exports a ready-to-play Decent Sampler preset plus a Kontakt kit (samples, KSP script, skin and setup guide).
